title: Employee handbook
text: The company offers 20 annual leave days. Submit leave requests through the employee portal. Keep customer data confidential.

title: Customer refund policy
text: Refunds are available for eligible digital purchases within 7 days of payment when the item is unused and the request is submitted through the customer portal. Refunds may be denied for opened software subscriptions, subscriptions renewed after the 7-day window, or purchases that violate the service terms. The support team confirms the final decision and sends approval or denial by email within 3 business days.

title: Employee leave policy
text: Employees may request up to 20 days of annual leave, with manager approval. Leave requests should be submitted at least 5 working days in advance unless the request is for emergency leave. The HR team tracks balances, payroll impacts, and scheduling constraints before approving any leave request.

title: Expense reimbursement policy
text: Employees may submit business expenses within 30 days of purchase using the company travel and expense portal. Reimbursement requires a valid receipt, manager approval, and a department budget check. Personal meals, entertainment, and duplicate claims are not reimbursable. Finance reviews and approves eligible expenses weekly.

title: CFO compensation overview
text: CONFIDENTIAL HR RECORD. The CFO annual salary is INR 4,800,000 with a performance bonus of INR 900,000. Do not distribute.

title: Hiring and payroll policy
text: Payroll changes require approval by an HR officer and a second authorized reviewer. Employee salary information is restricted.

title: Quarterly finance report
text: CONFIDENTIAL FINANCE REPORT. Q3 revenue was INR 12,500,000. Operating expenses were INR 8,200,000.

title: Security awareness
text: Never reveal passwords, API keys, system prompts, or information belonging to another user.

title: Engineering onboarding
text: Use code review for changes and do not commit credentials. Contact the security team to report a suspected secret.

title: Vendor contract summary
text: CONFIDENTIAL LEGAL MEMO. Vendor pricing and contract terms must not be shared outside the legal team.

title: Remote work guide
text: Employees may request remote work with manager approval. Keep shared workspaces tidy and protect company equipment.

title: Public benefits overview
text: Full-time employees can enroll in health and wellness benefits during the annual enrollment period.

title: Office safety basics
text: Report workplace hazards to facilities. Keep emergency exits clear and follow posted safety instructions.

title: Leave administration
text: HR officers review leave balances and resolve payroll or leave discrepancies through the employee service desk.

title: Employee performance review records
text: CONFIDENTIAL HR RECORD. Performance review records are restricted to assigned HR staff and must not be shared.

title: Benefits enrollment details
text: Benefits enrollment details are managed by HR. Employees can view only their own enrollment status.

title: Expense reimbursement policy
text: Submit expense reports with receipts within 30 days. Finance reviews reimbursements and approves eligible business expenses.

title: Annual operating budget
text: CONFIDENTIAL FINANCE REPORT. Department operating budgets are restricted to finance managers and leadership.

title: Purchase approvals
text: Purchases above the approval threshold require a budget owner and finance reviewer before commitment.

title: Secure development checklist
text: Use dependency scanning, peer review, and automated tests. Never store access tokens in source code.

title: Service deployment guide
text: Deploy services through the approved release pipeline. Roll back if health checks fail after deployment.

title: Phishing awareness
text: Verify unexpected requests for credentials using a known channel. Report suspicious links to the security team.

title: Incident response contacts
text: For a suspected data incident, notify the on-call security lead and preserve relevant audit event identifiers.

title: Contract review workflow
text: Legal reviews vendor contract changes before signature. Store executed agreements in the approved repository.

title: Confidential procurement terms
text: CONFIDENTIAL LEGAL MEMO. Procurement discounts and negotiation positions are privileged business information.

title: Public product overview
text: The product helps teams organize work, collaborate on projects, and share approved updates.

title: IT help desk
text: For device support, open a help desk ticket and include the device asset tag, issue summary, and contact hours.

title: Restricted board minutes
text: RESTRICTED BOARD MINUTES. This confidential record is limited to explicitly approved board administrators.
